theorems.name: Submission.weight_portmanteau_of_radonConverges
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → (∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → V.weight O ≤ liminf (fun i ↦ (Vi i).weight O) atTop) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun i ↦ (Vi i).weight K) atTop ≤ V.weight K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
